name: Verifiable
description: Verifiable is an API-first healthcare credentialing platform that automates provider verification and network management. The platform provides real-time primary source verification, continuous monitoring, and a comprehensive provider data API, making it popular with digital health companies, health plans, and healthcare organizations that need to programmatically verify and manage provider credentials at scale.

pricing.notes: Verifiable offers flexible pricing models including per-verification, per-provider, and enterprise arrangements. Volume discounts available. API-first approach means pricing can be tailored to specific use cases.

company.description: Verifiable is a venture-backed healthcare technology company focused on automating provider verification through API-first infrastructure and real-time data connections.

compliance.notes: Verifiable maintains SOC 2 Type II certification and supports NCQA credentialing requirements

faqs.question: How much does Verifiable cost per verification?
faqs.answer: Verifiable pricing starts at $5-15 per individual verification for their API platform. Continuous monitoring runs $2-5 per provider per month. Full credentialing platform access is $50-150 per provider per month. Enterprise pricing with unlimited API calls is available for high-volume users.

faqs.question: How fast is Verifiable's license verification?
faqs.answer: Verifiable provides real-time license verification that typically returns results in seconds to minutes, depending on the state. Full primary source verification takes 24-48 hours. Their API responses for cached data are sub-second, making it ideal for real-time verification workflows.

faqs.question: Does Verifiable have an API?
faqs.answer: Yes, Verifiable is built API-first with a comprehensive REST API for all verification and credentialing functions. The platform includes webhooks for real-time notifications, bulk verification endpoints, and is designed for programmatic integration into existing healthcare systems and workflows.

faqs.question: What can Verifiable verify?
faqs.answer: Verifiable can verify state medical licenses, DEA registrations, board certifications, NPI numbers, education credentials, and work history. They also provide NPDB queries, OIG/SAM exclusion screening, state sanctions monitoring, and continuous credential monitoring across all verification types.
